name: answers a retention question from the retrieved passage and cites it
input: How long are audit logs kept in hot storage, and what happens to them at the end of that period?
notes: The whole answer is in one document. Retrieval has to put that document in front of generation, and generation has to attribute what it says to it.

assertions.why: an answer the model could produce without the passage says nothing about retrieval
an answer a reader cannot trace back to a document is an answer they cannot check
